title: Index probe requests an absent keyspace
root_cause: The script asks Cassandra to use the scans keyspace, which is not present in the service. The cqlsh error is followed by a generic script failure.

relevant_evidence.why: The database reports the absent keyspace before the script fails.
The script invokes cqlsh using scans and exits on failure.
The job starts the Cassandra service and publishes its CQL port.
